purpose: Determine whether the duplicated S10 edge_0065/tunnel_3 floor hole admits a nearby footprint-scale location with real, height-continuous mesh support and unchanged clearance contracts.

approval.scope: One read-only 2-observation x 41 x 41 local floor-support audit at S10 frames 338/2275; zero training, inference, graph, C09/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续, 继续2, 继续 after receiving the exact footprint-scale support-audit proposal.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only research audit of sealed generated assets.

sampling.rule: Preserve both reverse-traversal observations at frames 338/2275. Around each axis x/y evaluate ±1.0m at exact 0.05m spacing: 1681 cells per observation. A floor hit is support only if its z differs by <=0.25m from axis_z+FTA. Only supported cells receive horizontal/up/down clearance rays. Parameter cells are not independent samples.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Sealed mesh first hits and generator axis_z+FTA define physical support continuity.
teacher.valid_mask: Feasible requires real floor support within 0.25m expected height, sensor down=1.00±0.05m, horizontal/up>=0.8m. A robust common region must be feasible in both duplicate observations and contain >=9 four-neighbour cells.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Local diagnostic only; no trajectory is rewritten.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only S10 C08 trajectory and mesh are read; C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D; <=2420640 horizontal and <=10086 vertical rays; zero GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: 3362-row candidate CSV, common support components and exact conditional ray counts.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Two floor-height-error heatmaps and one common-feasible heatmap over full ±1m extent.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop on hash/count/forbidden-read loss; robust support absence is a valid diagnostic result, not an execution failure.
